d:
Bihar vidhanasbha chunav ke shuruaati rujhanon men endie ko bari barhat milti huee dikh rahi hai. vahin mahagathbandhan kaphi pichhe hoti huee nazar aa rahi hai. bihar ke in chunavi rujhanon par dekhie bibisi hindi ka ye khas karyakram.
• bibisi hindi se aap in soshal midiya chainals par bhi jur sakte hain-
